sources.snippet: The project extends llama.cpp with bounded routed-expert streaming: the large MoE expert payload stays on NVMe and the active slices move through fixed-size host buffers into two GPUs. The tested model is Antirez's 80.8 GiB mixed-precision GGUF, while the operational context is capped at 98,304 tokens.

sources.snippet: MoE expert routing is the closest model architecture to an index because the router selects only a subset of expert weights. The disk-first runtime does not cache the full model in RAM, but dense-model latency cannot be eliminated by the query language alone.
